title: Passport Size Photo Maker: 3.5×4.5 cm, Pixels and KB
description: Free passport size photo maker: 3.5 × 4.5 cm (276 × 354 px) for Indian forms or square 51 × 51 mm, with a KB limit such as 20 KB. Nothing is uploaded.
intro: Turn any clear selfie or photo into a passport size photo for an online form. Choose the size, set a KB limit if needed, and download. Need prints? Send it to the photo sheet tool.

steps.name: Add a photo
steps.text: Use a recent, front-facing picture with a plain white or light background and even light.

steps.name: Choose the size
steps.text: Pick 3.5 × 4.5 cm for Indian exam and job forms. Choose the square 51 × 51 mm only when your application asks for it.

steps.name: Set the KB
steps.text: If the form says "under 20 KB" or "up to 50 KB", type that number in Max size.

steps.name: Download or print
steps.text: Save the JPG once the checks pass, or open the photo sheet tool to print several copies.

faq.q: What is the passport size photo size in cm?
faq.a: On Indian exam, job and admission forms, "passport size" almost always means 3.5 cm wide by 4.5 cm tall (35 × 45 mm). Photo studios print the same size.

faq.q: How many pixels is a passport size photo?
faq.a: A 3.5 × 4.5 cm photo is 276 × 354 px at 200 DPI and 413 × 531 px at 300 DPI. The square 51 × 51 mm option is 402 × 402 px at 200 DPI and 602 × 602 px at 300 DPI.

faq.q: Which size do I need for a passport application?
faq.a: Passport and visa rules can differ from exam forms; many ask for a square 2 × 2 inch (51 × 51 mm) photo. Always follow the photo instructions given with your own application.

faq.q: How do I make a passport size photo of 20 KB?
faq.a: Type 20 in Max size. A 276 × 354 px photo fits under 20 KB comfortably while still looking sharp; the pass check confirms the final size.

sections.h2: Passport size width and height, explained
paras: Two different sizes travel under the same name. On Indian application forms and at local studios, passport size is the upright 3.5 × 4.5 cm photo. The square 51 × 51 mm (2 × 2 inch) photo is asked for by some passport and visa applications. Pick the size your form names; when it gives only pixels, follow the pixels.
Many exams skip centimetres altogether. Banking forms, for instance, want 200 × 230 px between 20 and 50 KB. For those, open the exam kit, which already knows the pixels and KB range.
For paper copies, the photo sheet tool lays out 4 copies on 4 × 6 inch photo paper or up to 16 on A4, with cut lines, at 300 DPI. Print at 100% so each copy keeps its true size.
